Bootlegs for trade

Shows I’m actively looking for. If you have any of them, please get in touch: I’ll gladly trade for them.

Trading rules
  1. Online trades only: Mega, WeTransfer, SwissTransfer, Pixeldrain or MediaFire.
  2. If you contact me first, you send first.
  3. Lossless only. I trust you to check your files before sending them.
  4. One show for one show, regardless of length or number of discs. Exception: if I have both the 16-bit and 24-bit versions of a show and you want both, I’ll send both and it counts as one show.
  5. No selling, ever.

If you have questions about lineage, duration, info files or anything else, just ask and I’ll gladly provide the information.

Contact

Send me the list of shows you want, along with what you can offer in return.
